meta.name: relight
meta.description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.

copy.tagline: 改变静态图片的光照方向、色温和氛围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调整图片的光照效果或氛围。
copy.tagline_en: Change lighting direction, color temperature, and mood of a still image
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to adjust lighting or mood in images.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能改变一张静态图片的光照方向、色温、强度和氛围，同时保留主体、姿势和构图。它会自动选择最合适的 AI 模型来完成重打光。
howto.when: 当你明确要求改变图片的光照，比如提到“重打光”、“改成黄金时刻”、“加轮廓光”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这张产品图改成暖色窗口光，从左边打过来。
给这张人像加上金色黄昏的轮廓光，从背后打。
say.note: Claude 会保留人物身份和姿势，只改变光照。

say.text: 把这张风景照从正午改成蓝色时刻的氛围。
say.note: Claude 会使用描述式编辑模型处理场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can change the lighting direction, color temperature, intensity, and mood of a still image while preserving subject identity, pose, and framing. It automatically selects the best AI model for the relighting task.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to alter the lighting of an image, e.g., mentioning "relight", "golden hour", "rim light", or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Relight this product photo with warm window light from the left.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Qwen Edit Relight model.

say_en.text: Add a golden hour rim light from behind to this portrait.
say_en.note: Claude preserves identity and pose, only changes lighting.

say_en.text: Change this landscape from noon to blue hour mood.
say_en.note: Claude uses a description-based edit model for broader scene context.
